Wills Flooring installs vinyl plank in Everett rentals at $2.50 per sq ft labor plus $100 per stair, and we bring the exact products that meet this spec to the property so you can compare them on the floor.

blocks.html: Everett landlords are, in our experience, the most practical flooring buyers there are. The question is never which floor is prettiest. It is which floor lets you allow pets, charge the deposit, and turn the unit in a weekend without recarpeting. Whether it is a 1990s Silver Lake split-level rented to a Boeing family with a lab, a duplex in Riverside with an uneven old subfloor, or a Port Gardner condo with HOA sound rules, the answer is a specific vinyl plank spec, not a brand. Here is the spec, why each line matters when a dog lives there, and the landlord math behind it.

rows: Dense and dent-resistant. Crates, water bowls and dropped dog food cans leave no mark. Softer WPC cores dent under crate legs over a year.
20 mil minimum, 22 to 28 mil if the budget allows
The wear layer is the only thing between claws and the printed pattern. 12 mil is fine for a quiet owner-occupied bedroom and wrong for a rental with a dog.
Gloss shows every scratch and every paw print. Texture and a matte finish hide the daily wear between tenant turnovers.
Mid-tone brown or greige with grain variation
Very dark shows hair and dust; very light shows dirt and stains. Variation hides the one plank you replace later.
5 to 6 mm with an attached pad
The pad quiets nails on a second floor and takes the edge off subfloor imperfections in older Everett houses. Condos usually need a stated IIC rating for the HOA.
Lets a damaged plank be swapped without replacing the room. Keep at least one full box from the same lot.

blocks.text: What pets actually do to a floor, and what stops it

items.title: Nails on the path to the door
items.text: A dog runs the same route to the back door thousands of times a year. On a thin wear layer that route dulls into a visible lane within one lease. 20 mil plus a textured surface keeps the lane invisible for years.

items.title: Accidents at the seams
items.text: The plank is waterproof; the joints are not sealed. Urine that sits overnight can wick into a click joint and reach the subfloor, which is where odor lives. A tight-locking plank and a quick-cleaning tenant matter more than any waterproof claim.

items.title: Crates, bowls and beds
items.text: Static weight in one spot dents soft cores. SPC does not dent, and a mat under the water bowl solves the rest. Write the mat into the lease if you want.

items.title: Noise below
items.text: Nails on hard plank in an upstairs Eastmont unit carry to the tenant below. An attached acoustic pad plus a proper underlayment on a wood subfloor keeps neighbors and the Port Gardner HOA quiet.

blocks.title: Waterproof does not mean odor-proof:
blocks.text: If a tenant leaves after months of accidents, the plank will look fine and the room will still smell. Pull a plank near the worst spot, check the subfloor, and treat or replace it before the next lease. Do this before you blame the floor.
Mistakes landlords make with vinyl plank

items.html: Buying the cheapest plank on the pallet. A 6 or 8 mil wear layer will look tired after one dog. The savings on material disappear at the first turnover. Our guide to cheap vs premium vinyl plank shows where the money goes.
Choosing a dark, glossy plank to look upscale. It photographs well for the listing and shows every hair and scratch by the second month.
Skipping the spare box. Dye lots change. Without a matching box, one deep gouge means a mismatched plank or a whole-room replacement.
Installing over the old subfloor problems. A Riverside duplex with a wavy floor needs leveling first. Rigid plank spans small dips but breaks locks over big ones.
Forgetting the HOA in a condo. Port Gardner buildings usually require a sound rating for hard flooring. Get the underlayment approved before the order goes in.

faq.q: What wear layer do I need for a rental with dogs?
faq.a: 20 mil at minimum. The wear layer is the clear coat that takes the abuse, and 12 mil plank that works in an owner's bedroom wears into visible paths under a dog in a rental. Stepping to 20 to 28 mil costs more per box and is the single best upgrade for a pet-friendly unit.

faq.q: Is vinyl plank really waterproof against pet accidents?
faq.a: The planks are. The joints between them are not sealed, so urine left overnight can wick through to the subfloor and cause odor. A tight-locking rigid plank, prompt cleanup and a check of the subfloor at turnover solve it. Waterproof means the plank survives, not that the smell does not.

faq.q: How much does it cost to install vinyl plank in an Everett rental?
faq.a: Wills Flooring's labor is $2.50 per sq ft with a 500 sq ft minimum and $100 per stair. An 850 sq ft unit with 13 stairs is $3,425 in labor. The plank, removal of old carpet and any subfloor work are separate lines quoted at the free estimate.

faq.q: Should I use vinyl plank on the stairs too?
faq.a: In a pet unit, yes. Carpeted stairs are the first thing to look worn and smell, and wrapping them in the same plank with matching stair noses makes the whole unit one surface to clean. Stairs are $100 each in labor.

faq.q: Can a single damaged plank be replaced?
faq.a: Yes, if you kept a box from the same lot. On a click-lock floor a plank near a wall is lifted out and replaced; a mid-room plank is cut out and the replacement glued in. Glue-down plank is replaced one piece at a time. Either way, order one extra box at install.

faq.q: Does vinyl plank work in an Everett condo with HOA rules?
faq.a: Usually, with an underlayment that meets the building's sound rating. Most Port Gardner and downtown condos state a required IIC number for hard floors. Bring the rule to the estimate and we specify a pad and underlayment that pass, in writing.
